title: Vegan Ehomaki Hazelnut Delight
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert made with hazelnuts, caramel, and ehomaki. This vegan delight is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Cut each ehomaki sheet into 4 equal pieces.
In a food processor, grind the hazelnuts until coarsely chopped.
In a saucepan, melt the caramel over low heat.
Add the chopped hazelnuts to the melted caramel and stir until well combined.
Place a piece of ehomaki on a flat surface and spread a small amount of the hazelnut-caramel mixture onto it.
Place a kissed date on top of the mixture and fold the ehomaki to form a triangle.
Repeat the process with the remaining ehomaki and filling ingredients.
Place the rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with coconut oil and bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the rolls to cool before serving.
